name: Kamikaze
source: A Kamikaze type monster girl. This Kamikaze will appear randomly in dungeons and challenge [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] on second playthroughs. She's looking for a strong master to join. Because Leo cannot choose to ejaculate inside her she will never become pregnant and has no child version.
translation: A Kamikaze type monster girl. This Kamikaze will appear randomly in dungeons and challenge [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] on second playthroughs.
